text: Window Stats 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的会话统计插件，在会话视图中加入窗口统计和会话分析标签，并在侧栏与右侧浮层显示全局概览。窗口统计把各会话的状态、轮次、步骤、输入输出 Token、缓存、上下文、耗时与估算费用汇总为可排序筛选的列表和详情；会话分析按时间范围展示每日 Token 趋势、工具耗时分布和轮次摘要。插件还注册 tokenHistory 投影以汇总每日输入与输出 Token，支持按工作区分组、切换货币并快速打开会话。适合需要在 DSH Web 中比较多个会话进展和用量的用户；需要安装到 Web profile，不要求额外 API Key。

Window Stats adds cross-session statistics and analysis to DeepSeek Harness Web: compare session status, tokens, context, duration and estimated cost; chart daily token usage and tool activity; and open sessions from a sidebar summary or overview panel.
想在 DSH Web 里一眼比较所有会话的进度和 Token 用量
需要按工作区筛选或分组会话，并查看每个会话的详细用量
想分析当前对话在一段时间内调用了哪些工具、各花了多久
希望查看每天输入和输出 Token 的变化趋势
Show me token usage and progress across all my DSH Web sessions.
I want to review tool time and turn activity for a selected time range.
功能「跨会话窗口统计」：在会话视图打开窗口统计标签，按行查看各会话状态、轮次、Token、上下文和耗时，并排序、筛选或分组。
功能「会话分析」：在当前会话打开分析标签并选择预设或自定义时间范围，查看 Token 趋势、工具类型耗时分布和逐轮摘要。
功能「全局概览」：侧栏显示运行会话数、Token 总量和估算费用；展开右侧概览可查看运行中、Token 消耗较高和最近活动的会话，并点击打开。
功能「每日 Token 历史」：插件注册 tokenHistory 会话投影，将 assistant/message 事件中的输入与输出 Token 按 UTC 日期累加，供会话分析页绘制每日趋势。
想从侧栏快速查看运行会话数、总 Token 和估算费用
Open a session directly from a global panel of recent and active sessions.

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · Introduction：

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · What this plugin provides：Installing this bundle adds a cross-session observability surface to every session of the target dsh profile. It reads the official `tokenUsage` / `sessionStats` / `contextPressure` / `contextBreakdown` projections (plus a `tokenHistory` projection it registers itself), so no host service or new RPC is required beyond that one projection unit.

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · What this plugin provides：| Surface | What it shows |
|---|---|
| `窗口统计` view tab | One row per session: status, turns/steps, input/output tokens, cache-hit ratio, context occupancy, duration, cost, last activity — with sort / filter / group-by-workspace / model & currency selectors, and a right detail panel (token buckets, context composition, timing, heatmap). |
| `会话分析` view tab | Time-range analysis (presets + custom) of the current session: token trend chart, tool-type duration distribution (donut + bars), and per-turn task summaries. |
| Sidebar footer summary | Always-visible running count, total tokens, and cost. |
| Right overview drawer | Collapsed by default; expands to a running-sessions + top-token-consumers + recent-activity panel with click-to-open. |

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · Data source：| Displayed | Source |
|---|---|
| turns / steps / wall times | `sessionStats` projection |
| input / output / cache tokens | `tokenUsage` projection |
| context occupancy / composition | `contextPressure` + `contextBreakdown` projections |
| per-day token history (heatmap) | `tokenHistory` projection (registered by this plugin) |
| status | `SessionSummary.running` / `pendingInteraction` / `completed` |

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · Data source：Cost is estimated from DeepSeek's official pricing (V4-Flash / V4-Pro, cache-hit / cache-miss / output priced separately) with USD / CNY / EUR / GBP / JPY switching.

@wellorbetter/dsh-plugin-window-stats README · Use：- **Sidebar** — the footer shows running count + total tokens + cost at all times.
- **窗口统计 tab** — open any session and click the tab to see every session's progress, tokens, and cost; click a row for a rich breakdown; use the toolbar to sort / filter / group / switch model & currency.
- **会话分析 tab** — analyze the current session over a time range, by tool type, with a token trend chart and task summaries.
- **Right drawer** — click the edge handle to expand the running / top-tokens / recent overview, click any row to open it.
